'''Mehar Grot''' was the [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] of [[Alliance Base 16]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gaulus/Legends|Gaulus]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Grot became aware that an [[espionage droid]] had compromised the base's location, and requested evacuation as soon as possible, as well as informing [[Channe Dar]] of [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]].
